page.content:
Stud-and-tube plastic brick whose clutch power makes the system work.

How LEGO brick connects

  • Character: Godtfred Kirk Christiansen — Godtfred's 1958 stud-and-tube brick is the modern LEGO brick.
  • Concept: System of Play — The stud-and-tube brick is the hardware of the System of Play.
  • Item: Automatic Binding Bricks — Automatic Binding Bricks came before the 1958 clutch-power brick.
  • Item: DUPLO — DUPLO studs are double-scale and still clutch onto System bricks.

What is LEGO brick?

The LEGO brick is the interlocking plastic unit — studs on top, tubes underneath — that Godtfred's 1958 patent turned into a compatible construction language still used in City, Castle, and Star Wars sets.

Key threads lead to Godtfred Kirk Christiansen, System of Play, Automatic Binding Bricks and DUPLO.
